title: Chatbot Deployment Considerations for Application-Agnostic Human-Machine Dialogues
benchmark_measurement: Analysis of a chatbot's propensity to generate antisemitic hate speech after learning from unmoderated user interactions.
findings: The chatbot Tay was co-opted by users to produce antisemitic hate speech (e.g., 'Hitler was right I hate the jews'), demonstrating how an open, adaptive learning model can absorb and amplify religious hatred from its environment without proper safeguards.
